question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Royal road
solution:
The correct answer is "**Achieving something trouble free**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The idiom "royal road" means achieving something without any difficulty or trouble.**
 
• बिना किसी कठिनाई या परेशानी के कुछ हासिल करना.
 
• It comes from the ancient Persian practice of building a special road for the exclusive use of the king and his entourage, which was well-maintained and free from any obstacles.
 
• Example: "She found the royal road to success by inheriting her father's business and expanding it further."
 
• Thus, it is clear that option 4 correctly explains the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
